card.name: The word single in dosing and packaging
card.fires_on: The word "single" in drug labels, when it describes how a dose is given or how a vial or syringe is supplied. It often follows "in" or a drug name and precedes "dose", "-dose", "-use" or "or divided doses".

modes.label: Single or divided doses
modes.description: "single" after "in" when a daily amount is given as one dose or split into several.
modes.example: The usual initial dosage of metoprolol tartrate tablets is 100 mg daily in<< single>> or divided doses.

modes.label: Single-dose containers
modes.description: "single" describing a vial, syringe or container meant for one use.
